title: GARNIER charter ratified
subtitle: Accepted with amendments by Stanley Bishop on 2026-09-15.
footer_text: Commissioned through Berthier. Agent-authored proposal; Stanley ratifies.

sections.title: Keep the codename GARNIER
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Use GARNIER as the working codename.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Preserve the predecessor measurement boundary
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: No GARNIER site change ships before HAUSSMANN P5.2 evidence is frozen; predecessor panel, rescore and GR-7 remain separately owned.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Evolve the existing visual voice
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Evolve the five-slot Ghibli-pixel program under ADR-053 and ADR-059; preserve semantic order, theme contrast and equivalent text.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Constrain generated imagery
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Generated imagery, if used, is abstract-only, VisualDNA-governed and documented with provenance and accessible alt/decorative treatment.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Serve funders through evidence
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Serve funders through people, lineage, operational state and participation evidence; no dedicated investors page.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Use three human reader classes
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Fresh-context synthetic prescreens; operator-supplied formative humans before visual production; predeclared final answer key and retest policy; at least five per decisive class and at least 80% passing in each window. Human elapsed time is separate.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Keep the tier enum unchanged
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Keep executor_tier within fable/opus/sonnet; executor_runtime remains codex. Allocate judgment classes by actual mission work under amended D-9.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Keep setup local and pinned
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Setup remains local, reversible and pinned; raw evidence ignored where appropriate. No outward installs or credential values in records.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Adopt the derived campaign envelope
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Phase-by-phase budget commitment. Initial P0 envelope stays 123 kT; later phase estimates are provisional until their preceding human gate. Original 1,637 kT estimate preserved. Amended forecast 2,310 kT across 38 missions and 47 agent sittings is uncalibrated and is not blanket spending authority.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

sections.title: Adopt measured prose budgets
sections.question: Resolved by operator chat
sections.verdict: Keep measured word targets as editorial guidance. Exceeding a target requires a written reason; comprehension, prerequisite/consent meaning and accessibility outrank reduction. Unsupported claims remain blocking.
sections.analysis: See charter_ratification_20260915 for the accepted amendment and authority.

composite_question: Adopt Decade 1 and provisional Decade 2 with the decisions recorded above?

sitrep.gate_purpose: Ratify the 26-mission campaign after reviewing evidence limits.
sitrep.importance_reason: Sets scope, budget and human gates.
